selection_policy: 27 reviewed/reclassified historical F tasks plus 7 new schedule and 1 new OAuth full official CPU replays. Excludes statement-shuffle algorithms, static numeric predicates, duplicated functions and failed async-timeout replays.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Begin attempts one through four with stop_after_attempt(3). The stop predicate must receive the live retry state so early attempts continue and later attempts stop.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Live retry_state must reach configured stop callback instead of None; propagation primary.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Live retry_state must reach configured stop callback instead of None; propagation primary.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: After a non-stopping decision the controller must schedule sleep, advance idle_for and attempt_number, then emit DoSleep; after a stopping decision it must surface the retry error. The rewrite drops next-attempt accounting.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Stop outcome controls error versus next-action/sleep stages; accounting must precede before_sleep.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Stop outcome controls error versus next-action/sleep stages; accounting must precede before_sleep.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: A fresh call with no outcome must reset iteration state before selecting DoAttempt; a failed TryAgain outcome must take the explicit-retry branch. Resetting after reading the outcome corrupts the branch.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Reset iteration state, inspect prior outcome, then enqueue before/attempt or retry actions.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Reset iteration state, inspect prior outcome, then enqueue before/attempt or retry actions.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Closing must flush, close the fd, wait for kernel status, terminate only if alive, then mark fd -1 and closed. Moving flush outside and gating fd assignment on aliveness raises on clean exits instead of closing.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Flush while open, close descriptor, reap/terminate, then publish closed state; primary resource lifecycle.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Flush while open, close descriptor, reap/terminate, then publish closed state; primary resource lifecycle.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Incrementing wait must keep start/increment/max in order so attempt sleeps grow linearly and cap at max. Rotating the three arguments corrupts the attempt-sleep-end chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Constructor start/increment/max inputs are assigned to the wrong state fields.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Constructor start/increment/max inputs are assigned to the wrong state fields.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Update flush must invoke the callback on queued rows, sort and group by keys into update_many calls, then clear the queue; clearing first persists nothing and reports empty across the queue-flush-persist chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Consume callback and sorted update groups before queue clearing; persistent batch lifecycle.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Consume callback and sorted update groups before queue clearing; persistent batch lifecycle.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Blocking iteration must begin a new call and build attempt state before the first DoAttempt. Beginning after the loop leaves attempt_number/idle uninitialized for the first attempt-sleep-end cycle.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Initialize new call and retry state before its first attempt.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Initialize new call and retry state before its first attempt.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Exiting a chunked writer must flush queued rows on both clean and exceptional exits. Skipping the flush on clean exits loses the produce-flush-persist chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Context exit must flush pending buffer on clean exit; primary cleanup.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Context exit must flush pending buffer on clean exit; primary cleanup.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Chained waits must keep stage order so early attempts use the first stage and late attempts reuse the last. Reversing stages swaps early/late sleeps across the attempt-sleep-end chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Caller-provided strategy collection is reversed while storing configuration; ordered payload propagation primary.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Caller-provided strategy collection is reversed while storing configuration; ordered payload propagation primary.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Update must queue the supplied row so the exit flush persists it. Queuing None breaks the produce-queue-flush chain and crashes grouping.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Actual item must reach parent queue-add consumer instead of None.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Actual item must reach parent queue-add consumer instead of None.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Jittered exponential wait must keep initial/max/exp_base/jitter roles so sleeps grow exponentially within bounds; rotating the four arguments collapses every sleep to the cap across the attempt-sleep-end chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Constructor initial/max/exp_base/jitter inputs are assigned to each others state fields.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Constructor initial/max/exp_base/jitter inputs are assigned to each others state fields.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Bulk update must iterate every supplied row into chunks for execution; deleting the loop persists nothing across the produce-execute-read chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Consume queued rows into full/final batches, execute each, then clear batch state.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Consume queued rows into full/final batches, execute each, then clear batch state.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Bulk insert must sync columns from all rows then persist every row in order; syncing only the first row and reordering drops columns and rows across the produce-persist-read chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Synchronize all schema columns before inserting chunks and persist the final partial chunk.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Synchronize all schema columns before inserting chunks and persist the final partial chunk.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Conditional insert must persist a missing row and skip an existing one by key; always returning false without inserting loses the check-persist-read chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Missing-row read must transition to insert; early return prevents persistence.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Missing-row read must transition to insert; early return prevents persistence.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Waiting for no-echo must poll the echo flag until it clears or the timeout expires; deleting the poll loop returns None immediately, breaking the spawn-poll-detect chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Poll terminal echo until cleared or deadline expired; loop removal destroys temporal completion.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Poll terminal echo until cleared or deadline expired; loop removal destroys temporal completion.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Registering iteration actions must append each action exactly once in order; duplicating the first and dropping the rest corrupts the begin-retry-post execution chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Every registered action must be retained exactly once for later ordered execution.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Every registered action must be retained exactly once for later ordered execution.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Async action registration must append in order so begin runs before retry checks; prepending reverses the begin-retry-post execution chain.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Async action registration must preserve FIFO order rather than head insertion.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Async action registration must preserve FIFO order rather than head insertion.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Stream pod log lines with return_type str in order. Each line must decode, gate empty (end-of-log stops), then dispatch str fast-path. The bug checks empty only for reconnect so an ended str stream reconnect-loops instead of stopping.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Empty log stream read must end async iteration before reconnect/retry.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Empty log stream read must end async iteration before reconnect/retry.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Iterate two radio options in order. Each option must be built carrying the field validators, processed, then rendered with the required mark. The bug drops validators at option build so no option renders required.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Parent validators are omitted from each child option constructor.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Parent validators are omitted from each child option constructor.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Fetch group -> filter instances -> apply protection in order. The dispatcher must fetch the autoscaling group, filter instance_states by InstanceIds, then set ProtectedFromScaleIn on the filtered instances in that probe order. The bug applies before fetch so every call raises UnboundLocalError.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Configured protection flag must reach selected live instance state. Mutation applies before fetching receiver; no independent event timing proof.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Configured protection flag must reach selected live instance state. Mutation applies before fetching receiver; no independent event timing proof.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Capture the initial mutability, force the querydict mutable, yield it for parent injection, then restore the captured state in order. The bug consumes the capture before reading it so every entry raises.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Temporary mutability permission must restore original state on context exit.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Temporary mutability permission must restore original state on context exit.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Build the DRF request, gate the swagger fake view, inject each parent URL kwarg into data and query params, then return in order. The bug returns before building so every call raises.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Parent URL parameters must reach initialized child request, instead of early return.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Parent URL parameters must reach initialized child request, instead of early return.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Fetch the cached manager, create it on miss, register hookspecs, publish before entry-point loading, load each plugin, then mark loading complete in order. The bug publishes an uncreated manager and returns before loading so every call raises.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Cached manager must be published before recursive plugin loading; primary cache/reentrancy consistency.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Cached manager must be published before recursive plugin loading; primary cache/reentrancy consistency.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Resolve two properties sharing one $ref in order. The first must resolve, then the second must resolve identically with per-stack visit tracking. The bug shares one global visit set so the second resolves empty.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Sibling recursive branches must have independent visited-reference histories.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Sibling recursive branches must have independent visited-reference histories.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Discover configs in setup.cfg -> tox.ini -> .flake8 order across two directories in order. A malformed setup.cfg must be skipped without polluting later candidates, and a clean setup.cfg must be found. The bug reuses one parser so partial state leaks across candidates.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Fresh parser per candidate prevents previous config contents leaking into subsequent discovery.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Fresh parser per candidate prevents previous config contents leaking into subsequent discovery.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Fetch the source base folder, join the patch filename onto it, then load the patchset. The bug loads the raw filename so layout-relative patch files are never found.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Configured source_folder must reach patch-file lookup path.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Configured source_folder must reach patch-file lookup path.

mechanism_evidence.causal_contract: Start a response without a status code, ending in a ValueError. The bug skips validity checks so the missing status surfaces as a KeyError and double-start/body-first never raise.
mechanism_evidence.classification_correction: Response start/body/finish are distinct protocol states; invalid double-start/body-before-start and closed-channel checks enforce transitions.

root_second_read.causal_reason: Response start/body/finish are distinct protocol states; invalid double-start/body-before-start and closed-channel checks enforce transitions.
